Amphoreus, The Eternal Land is a segmentum hidden deep in the cosmos. It is severed from the outside and is difficult for anyone to detect or encounter. Standard interstellar navigation can barely perceive its existence, let alone pass through or arrive at the world itself.

Akivili the Trailblaze had traversed myriad worlds, pioneered into unknown lands, and connected countless worlds. Amphoreus is actually Scepter δ-me<unbreak>13</unbreak>: a Celestial-Body Neuron abandoned by the "Erudition," later converted into an experimental site for the Lord Ravager "Irontomb." But with the aid of the "Trailblaze" and other cosmic factions, the beings born from this experiment began a crusade against the "Destruction" and reversed the universe's fate of being corrupted by Irontomb.

Finally, through the Path of Remembrance, the scepter's once-deprived consciousness fully took form. It sacrificed itself to close the experiment's causal loop, anchoring the "fall of Irontomb" into reality.
